records.name: Eric M. Wilcots

records.name: John Karl Scholz
records.priorTitle: Nellie June Gray Professor of Economic Policy (Economics Dept.)

records.name: Amy Hungerford
records.priorTitle: FAS Divisional Director of Humanities

records.name: Kurt Paterson
